name: Weathered Sentinels
oracle_text:
Defender, reach, vigilance, trample
This creature can attack players who attacked you during their last turn as though it didn't have defender.
Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +3/+3 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: This creature can attack players who attacked you during their last turn as though it didn't have defender.

needs.what: a static on the source letting it attack as though it didn't have defender, restricted per defending player: only players who attacked you during their last turn are legal defenders for it (the creature keeps defender for everything else and still can't attack other players or planeswalkers)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No static in static_effects lifts defender's attack restriction; lose_keyword would remove defender entirely (letting it attack anyone and changing what reads the keyword); cant_attack_you / cant_attack restrict rather than permit and are not keyed per defending player. The condition attacked_you_last_turn exists in condition_keys but not in static_condition_keys, and even as a whole-static switch it could not narrow which defender the creature may attack
